companyLines.speaker: Second Opinion Tracing
companyLines.text: Second Opinion Tracing. We find people. We do not improve their reasons for being missing.

companyLines.speaker: You
companyLines.text: I am following up receipt SOT-17 supplied by Holly Gennaro for this investigation. Can you confirm the record she agreed to have checked?

companyLines.speaker: Second Opinion Tracing
companyLines.text: Her permission covers that enquiry. SOT-17 was our retainer for a search for John McClane, twelve days before your retainer began.

companyLines.speaker: You
companyLines.text: I also have a copy showing a date two days after my retainer. Its seal does not match your specimen.

companyLines.speaker: Second Opinion Tracing
companyLines.text: That is not the date in our retained record. The earlier date is correct. We cannot tell you who altered the later copy.

companyLines.speaker: You
companyLines.text: Did you merely open a missing-person search, or did Holly receive an indication that John had survived?

companyLines.speaker: Second Opinion Tracing
companyLines.text: We sent her a live-contact verification before your retainer began. Our delivery record contains her acknowledgement. She knew our result when she later hired you.

companyLines.speaker: You
companyLines.text: Did your report provide his current address?

companyLines.speaker: Second Opinion Tracing
companyLines.text: No. It verified a live contact, not a current address. We can confirm our report and delivery; we cannot identify who altered your copy or why she withheld this from you.

objective: Complete agency mission eleven, then examine the mission radio communications.
